purpose: Before another voice-extraction experiment, check whether the existing automatic diarization can supply stable solo profiles, without reference labels or text selecting them.
policy: Outside the exposed5m window; exactly one predicted person active; shrink each continuous solo span200ms per side; at least2s; choose earliest up to8s, maximum3clips per predicted identity, start separation>=30s. All selected clips retained, including bad ones.
readinessDiagnostic: After preparation only, check dominant actual reference identity consistency and>=95% exclusive reference speech coverage of each selected clip; this is a profile-purity diagnostic, not a model acceptance threshold or a selection filter.
